step1_figure.description: A folded-cascode OTA utilizing a PMOS differential input pair that folds into NMOS cascode devices. It features a PMOS wide-swing cascode current mirror load to provide high DC open-loop gain and a large output voltage swing.

open_loop_gain.description: Low-frequency DC voltage gain of the OTA.

equation.explanation: Gain is the product of the input pair transconductance and the total output resistance at the folding node.
equation.assumptions: Assumes all transistors are in strong inversion and saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the exact output resistance (lambda), which varies with channel length modulation and bias point.

unity_gain_frequency.description: The frequency at which the open-loop voltage gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

equation.explanation: Determined by the input pair transconductance charging the load capacitance.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the non-dominant poles are at much higher frequencies than f_un.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to g_m1, which scales with the square root of the tail current and mobility.

slew_rate.description: The maximum rate of change of the output voltage.

equation.explanation: During a large input step, the entire tail current is steered to one side of the diff pair and mirrored to charge/discharge the load capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the folding branch can sink/source the full tail current without turning off.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined strictly by the tail current source and the load capacitor.

phase_margin.description: The difference between the phase of the loop gain and -180 degrees at the unity-gain frequency.

equation.explanation: Phase margin is degraded by the non-dominant pole at the folding node.
equation.assumptions: Assumes a single dominant pole at the output and one effective non-dominant pole.

sky130_expected.calculation:
1. Non-dominant pole f_nd ≈ g_m4 / (2 * pi * C_fold).
2. Assuming parasitic C_fold ≈ 50 fF, f_nd = 348 uA/V / (2 * pi * 50 fF) = 1.1 GHz.
3. PM = 90 - arctan(11.25 MHz / 1.1 GHz) = 90 - 0.58° = 89.4°.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The non-dominant pole is very high frequency compared to the 11 MHz unity gain frequency, resulting in an excellent phase margin.

power_dissipation.description: Total static power consumed by the OTA.

equation.explanation: Sum of currents in the tail branch and the two folding branches multiplied by the supply voltage.
equation.assumptions: Assumes static DC conditions with zero differential input.

sky130_expected.calculation:
1. I_tail = 10 uA.
2. I_fold1 = I_fold2 ≈ 50 uA (set by VBN=0.7V on W/L=5 NMOS).
3. I_tot = 10uA + 50uA + 50uA = 110 uA.
4. P_diss = 1.8 V * 110 uA = 198 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact bias voltages VBN and VBP which set the folding branch currents.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive testbench measuring DC operating point, AC open-loop characteristics (Gain, UGF, PM), Transient step response (Slew Rate), and DC Output Swing.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Folded-Cascode OTA Comprehensive Testbench
.lib ${SKY130_PDK} tt
.options GMIN=1e-10 RELTOL=1e-4 ABSTOL=1e-12

* Define missing parameters for the netlist
.param W_XM1=10 L_XM1=1
.param W_XM2=10 L_XM2=1
.param W_XM3=5 L_XM3=1
.param W_XM4=5 L_XM4=1
.param W_XM5=5 L_XM5=1
.param W_XM6=5 L_XM6=1
.param W_XM7=10 L_XM7=1
.param W_XM8=10 L_XM8=1
.param W_XM9=10 L_XM9=1
.param W_XM10=10 L_XM10=1

* --- DUT Subcircuit ---
.subckt FOLDED_CASCODE_OTA VSS VDD VOUT VINN VINP VBN VBP VTAIL 
* PMOS differential input pair
XM1 NET1 VINP VTAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM1} l={L_XM1}
XM2 VOUT VINN VTAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM2} l={L_XM2}

* NMOS folding devices
XM3 NET1 VBN NET2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM3} l={L_XM3}
XM4 VOUT VBN NET3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM4} l={L_XM4}

XM5 NET2 VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM5} l={L_XM5}
XM6 NET3 VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_XM6} l={L_XM6}

* PMOS current mirror loads
XM7 NET1 NET1 NET5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM7} l={L_XM7}
XM8 VOUT NET1 NET6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM8} l={L_XM8}

* PMOS cascode (top)
XM9  NET5 VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM9} l={L_XM9}
XM10 NET6 VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_XM10} l={L_XM10}
.ends FOLDED_CASCODE_OTA

* --- Global Bias & Rails ---
VVDD  VDD_NODE   0   DC 1.8
VVSS  VSS_NODE   0   DC 0
VBN   VBN_NODE   0   DC 0.7
VBP   VBP_NODE   0   DC 1.0

* --- AC Testbench (Open Loop via large L/C) ---
* Fixed tail current to avoid shorting VDD to VTAIL
ITAIL_SRC VDD_NODE VTAIL_NODE DC 10e-6

VINP_AC VINP_NODE 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
L_FB VOUT_NODE VINN_NODE 1T
C_FB VINN_NODE 0 1T

XOTA VSS_NODE VDD_NODE VOUT_NODE VINN_NODE VINP_NODE VBN_NODE VBP_NODE VTAIL_NODE FOLDED_CASCODE_OTA
CLOAD VOUT_NODE VSS_NODE 1e-12

* --- TRAN & DC Testbench (Unity Gain Closed Loop) ---
ITAIL_TRAN_SRC VDD_NODE VTAIL_TRAN DC 10e-6

VINP_TRAN_SRC VINP_TRAN 0 DC 0.9 PULSE(0.4 1.4 1n 10p 10p 1u 2u)
R_FB_TRAN VOUT_TRAN VINN_TRAN 0

XOTA_TRAN VSS_NODE VDD_NODE VOUT_TRAN VINN_TRAN VINP_TRAN VBN_NODE VBP_NODE VTAIL_TRAN FOLDED_CASCODE_OTA
CLOAD_TRAN VOUT_TRAN VSS_NODE 1e-12

* --- Control Block ---
.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 10G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_NODE)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT_NODE))
meas ac dc_gain max gain_db
meas ac unity_gain_freq when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis (Slew Rate)
tran 1n 3u
meas tran v_max max v(VOUT_TRAN)
meas tran v_min min v(VOUT_TRAN)
meas tran t_rise trig v(VOUT_TRAN) val=0.6 rise=1 targ v(VOUT_TRAN) val=1.2 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(VOUT_TRAN) val=1.2 fall=1 targ v(VOUT_TRAN) val=0.6 fall=1
let sr_rise = 0.6 / t_rise
let sr_fall = 0.6 / t_fall
print sr_rise sr_fall

* 4. DC Sweep (Output Swing)
dc VINP_TRAN_SRC 0 1.8 0.01
let cl_gain = deriv(v(VOUT_TRAN))
meas dc vout_max when cl_gain=0.9 fall=1
meas dc vout_min when cl_gain=0.9 rise=1

quit
.endc
.end
